changelog: 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family Health Circle & Caregiver Management System (/family)
👥 Multi-Member Family Circles: Create groups, invite family members with granular relationships (Parent, Spouse, Child, Sibling, Grandparent, Guardian, Caregiver), and accept/reject invites

🛡️ Granular Caregiver Permissions: Explicit consent authorization for Medical ID, Medicine Schedule, Health Records, Appointments, SOS Alerts, and Medication Administration with 1-click access revocation
🔒 Strict Privacy & Data Isolation: Separate records for each family member — family membership does not grant automatic access to medical records without explicit patient consent

👴 Senior Citizen Mode (/senior-mode): Simplified high-contrast layout, giant touch-friendly buttons (>64px), 1-tap 108 Ambulance calling, 5-second SOS countdown, connected caregiver quick-dial, and 1-tap medication check-off
🚨 Family Emergency Live Monitor: Real-time SOS alerts, GPS coordinates with Google Maps links, impact detection alarms, family contact acknowledgements, and case resolution tracking
👶 Child Safety Emergency Profiles: Parental/legal guardian emergency management with explicit legal consent attestation, school/daycare contacts, pediatrician lines, and paramedic instructions
📋 Immutable Access Audit Trail: Chronological logging of all caregiver data accesses with timestamps, actor IDs, and accessed categories
🔔 Family Health Notifications: Coordinated emergency alerts, medication adherence logs, and hospital appointment updates across the circle
